identity: FANN Fashion is a men's fashion brand within the NSQ.global portfolio, entering through premium underwear.
Its core human experience is confidence, with comfort and personal identity central to how the wearer feels.
The approved brand promise is: Designed for Confidence. Engineered for Comfort.
The approved tagline is: Support in Style.
Legacy Line remains the currently retained product line; its exact launch assortment is not yet specified.
The current launch and website exclude X Edition and erotic-themed underwear.
voice: Brand promise: Designed for Confidence. Engineered for Comfort.
Both approved lines belong in the brand system; neither replaces the other.
Preserve the order: confidence is designed for; comfort is engineered for.
Voice is bold, direct and confident without aggression or crude expression.
Use concise, photography-led copy; avoid unsupported performance claims and generic luxury superlatives.
Do not use erotic-themed positioning for the current launch or website.
visual: Display and wordmark typography: Bank Gothic.
Light neutral and headline colour: Off-White #E8E6E0.
The current website must contain no erotic-themed imagery.

principles: Confidence is the central experience the brand should enable.
Comfort must be expressed through the actual garment, fit and construction as well as the brand promise.
Fashion and intimate apparel should reinforce personal identity and how the wearer feels.
Product facts must support published claims about performance, materials or manufacturing.
experience: Governing outcome: communicate confidence, comfort and identity through a clear fashion experience.
Proposed visitor journey: encounter the brand, understand the garment, see the reason to believe, choose the relevant product or line, gain fit reassurance, and take a clear next step.
Proposed composition principle: let the garment and its material detail carry the visual identity while typography makes the story easy to read.
Proposed interaction principle: use motion when it helps explain the brand or product, and retain a complete readable reduced-motion experience.
Proposed mobile principle: compose for the small screen explicitly rather than shrinking a desktop hero.
Proposed conversion principle: keep the next action accessible while the narrative unfolds.
website: Governing content: Bank Gothic and Montserrat; the promise Designed for Confidence. Engineered for Comfort.; the tagline Support in Style.
Scope constraint: no X Edition navigation, products, imagery, copy or coming-soon teaser in the current website.
Scope constraint: no erotic-themed underwear or erotic-themed campaign direction for the current release.
Retained line: Legacy Line; exact products and launch availability remain unspecified.
Recorded commerce direction: Shopify. A working FANN Shopify store has not been verified.
Intended primary public domain: fann.fashion. Ownership is recorded in prior sources; current DNS and deployment are unverified.
Secondary recorded domain: fannfashion.com; redirect behaviour remains unverified.
Implementation constraint: no invented prices, products, stock, technical claims, reviews, certifications, shipping promises or returns terms.
Preparation sequence: settle the minimum product and launch inputs, review concept imagery, select one direction, then implement and verify the site.
constraints: Approved brand promise, exact wording: Designed for Confidence. Engineered for Comfort.
Approved tagline, retained alongside the promise: Support in Style.
Exclude X Edition and erotic-themed underwear from the current launch and website. Any later reintroduction requires a new founder decision.
Use the dedicated repository for the consolidated brand and future website work.
